stem: What clinical sign was noted as evidence of a luxation injury in the case of the three-year-old who was punched?
explanation: The presence of blood at the gum line (gingival margin) is a key clinical indicator that the tooth has been loosened or displaced.
rationale: Look for a sign involving the soft tissue immediately surrounding the base of the tooth.

optionExplanations.A: Discoloration may happen later, but the immediate sign mentioned was related to the area where the tooth meets the gum.
optionExplanations.B: The presence of blood at the gum line (gingival margin) is a key clinical indicator that the tooth has been loosened or displaced.
optionExplanations.C: The tooth was loosened (luxated), not completely knocked out (avulsed).
optionExplanations.D: A fracture was noted on the adjacent tooth, but the luxation specifically refers to the loosening of the other tooth.

source.hint: Look for a sign involving the soft tissue immediately surrounding the base of the tooth.
